fields.description:
**Context**
The team needs to visually flag VIP players and VIP sign-ups distinctly, since a VIP player could in theory still have non-VIP sign-ups (and vice versa) — so the flag needs to live at both levels, not just one.

**Requirements**

* Player: confirm the existing VIP toggle/field on the Player record (Joyce referenced one already existing) and add a visual indicator — a small crown or star icon next to the Player's name — in list views and on the record itself.
* Sign-Up: add a new VIP flag/checkbox on the Sign-Up record itself (separate from the Player-level flag), since VIP status isn't guaranteed to be 1:1 with the player's sign-ups. Add the same style of icon indicator (crown) next to identifying info on sign-up list views.
* Icon-only display (rather than an additional visible field) was the team's preference where feasible — confirm this is buildable as an icon/formula-based indicator rather than a plain checkbox on the page layout.

**Constraints / Dependencies**
None called out.

**Source**
Fathom — WagerTech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync, 09/23/2026 (https://fathom.video/calls/831090060) — Joyce Kiddell \~57:32–1:04:14, Kobi Kunasekaran \~1:10:41–1:11:51, Emily Vandenberg \~1:11:34–1:11:45. Also Taryn's notes, Joyce VIP > "Icon star or crown for VIP players beside their name."
fields.summary: Player & Sign-Up: VIP flag + visual indicator (VIP)
